summary: This note describes PH7, an album by Peter Hammill first released on Charisma Records in September 1979. It was Hammill's eighth solo album and his final release on the Charisma label.
one_line: PH7 is Peter Hammill's 1979 eighth solo album, released on Charisma Records and his last release on that label.
key_facts: pH7 is an album by Peter Hammill.
pH7 was originally released on Charisma Records.
pH7 was originally released in September 1979.
pH7 was Peter Hammill's eighth solo album.
pH7 was Peter Hammill's last release on the Charisma label.
